Then evaluation at x satisfies ev_x(sigma.h)=sigma(h(x))=sigma.ev_x(h). Permutations preserve subset cardinality, so the map lands in the same P_delta(I_d). This verifies the elementary equivariance claimed at the page boundary under that action; it does not prove the displayed geometric identifications or replace tilde D_d by D_d^!.
